item.title: Largest Gift in LA Conservancy History Funds Altadena Heritage Project
item.description: The Los Angeles Conservancy announced Thursday it has received a $1.5 million grant from the Mellon Foundation, the largest single gift in the nonprofit’s history, to expand a community-driven effort documenting Altadena’s cultural heritage following the devastating Eaton Fire. item.description: A former executive at the cinema subscription service MoviePass who embezzled at least $260,000 from the company to repay money he borrowed to produce an event at the Coachella music festival in 2018 was sentenced Thursday to time already served.
